Here is an example of an sbatch script that runs Hugging Face training with multiple nodes:

```bash
#!/bin/bash

# Set the required variables
RCK_USERNAME=<your username>
RCK_PASSWORD=<your password>
TRAIN_DATA_PATH=<path to your training data>
MODEL_NAME=<name you want to give your model>
ALGORITHM=<training algorithm>
EPOCHS=<number of training epochs>

# Set the number of nodes to use
NODES=4

# Run the training script
huggingface/run-training.sh \
  --username=$RCK_USERNAME \
  --password=$RCK_PASSWORD \
  --data-path=$TRAIN_DATA_PATH \
  --train-dir=$TRAIN_DATA_PATH/train \
  --model-name=$MODEL_NAME \
  --algorithm=$ALGORITHM \
  --epochs=$EPOCHS \
  --num-workers=$NODES
